description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Lightning Crafter token's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 9.
Repeat from step 4.
